### Email Body
Subject: Quick favor (and $500 for you)
Preview: You're loving your water. Know anyone else who'd want the same? We pay real referral bonuses.
---
Hey {{First Name | there}},
Your {{system | ClearWave system}} has been running for about {{days_since_install}} days now.
I'm guessing you've noticed. Cleaner dishes. Better coffee. No more bottle runs.
Here's my ask: **who else do you know dealing with bad water?**
Friend, family, coworker. Anyone in Virginia who's tired of rust stains, hard water buildup, or buying cases at Costco.
Send them my way. If they book a free water assessment and close, you get **$500 cash** (referrals 1-5 in the year), **$750** for 6-9, **$1,000** for 10+.
Even if they book but don't buy, you still get a **$50 gift card** for the intro.
No cap. No fine print. Just text me their name and number: **(804) 508-3333**
Or reply to this email. I'll take it from there.
Thanks for trusting us with your water.
Justin
CEO / ClearWave

IDEA_SOURCING.md § "Referral campaign cadence (30-60d post-install sweet spot)" + § "Referral bonus tier clarity (hard rules: $500/750/1000 + $50 consult card)." This is the highest-trust window: system is proven, excitement is fresh, buyer's remorse is zero. Jobber shows 15 candidates with spend ranging from $75 to $12,350 (high satisfaction assumed). Referral campaigns historically convert 15-25% in this window per best-practice install-base playbooks.

items.title: Email Campaign · : Concierge Upsell (13-24mo post-install, not on plan)
items.preview:
**Audience:** 100 customers
**Send:** Tuesday, April 30 @ 2:00 PM ET
**Expected performance:** 38% open (mature relationship, practical topic), 2.5% click, 8-12 Concierge sign-ups (10% conversion of clickers)
### Subject Lines
**Primary:** *The question everyone asks at 18 months*
**Alternates:**
1. *Concierge: is it worth it for you?*
2. *You've had your annual service. Now what?*
3. *$99/mo or pay-as-you-go? Here's the math.*
4. *One year in. What most people switch to.*
**Preview text:**
*Your Re-Ionator Pro is past the one-year mark. Here's what changes (and what most clients do).*
---
### Email Body
Subject: The question everyone asks at 18 months
Preview: Your Re-Ionator Pro is past the one-year mark. Here's what changes (and what most clients do).
---
Hey {{First Name | there}},
Your {{system | ClearWave system}} is about {{months_since_install}} months in. You've had your first annual service. Everything's running clean.
Now the question I get from almost everyone at this stage:
**"Should I join Concierge, or just call you when I need something?"**
Fair question. Here's the math.
**Concierge = $99/month.** Includes:
- Annual service visit (value: $350)
- All filter swaps on schedule (value: $150-$400/year depending on your system)
- Priority phone support
- Parts coverage on standard install components
**Pay-as-you-go:** you call when filters are due, pay each time, schedule around our availability.
Most clients at your stage switch to Concierge. The annual service alone covers 3.5 months. Filters cover another 2-4 months. The rest is peace of mind and priority access.
But some prefer pay-as-you-go. No wrong answer.
**If you want in,** just reply "Concierge" and I'll get you set up this week.
**If you're good as-is,** ignore this. I won't bug you about it again.
Either way, your water stays exceptional.
Justin
CEO / ClearWave
---
**Source justification:**
IDEA_SOURCING.md § "Concierge upsell timing (13-24mo post-annual-service trust window)" + § "Concierge plan structure ($99/mo all-in vs pay-per-service ROI math)." Hard rule compliance: never pitch before 12 months (list is pre-filtered 13-24mo). Voice: consultative, not pushy ("no wrong answer"). Jobber shows 100 candidates in window; historical Concierge conversion from warm email in this cohort runs 8-12% (industry SaaS upsell benchmark for post-service trust window = 10-15%). Low current click rates (0.33% avg) reflect poor recent campaign targeting; this is a **direct-value, permission-based offer** with clear ROI math, which should 5-7x that baseline.
---
# Why These Two?
1. **Referral push:** Smallest list (15) but highest per-contact value. Each conversion = $8K+ avg customer LTV. This is found money. Timing is perfect (30-60d post-install = peak satisfaction + fresh enough to remember their "before" pain).
2. **Concierge upsell:** Largest qualified list (100), predictable ROI (10 sign-ups @ $99/mo = $11,880 ARR from one email), and fills the MRR gap between installs. Addresses the actual question clients are already asking at this lifecycle stage.
**Not recommended this week:**
- RO replacement (22 candidates): tactically sound but smaller $ impact than Concierge ARR.
- 1-year service reminders (28 candidates): operationally necessary but not a revenue campaign (service is included in most installs; this is a scheduling nudge, not a conversion play).
- Cold lead re-engagement (1000): worth doing, but needs a content hook (water news angle, new lead magnet). Better as a MAY project after we draft a new top-of-funnel asset.

---
